news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Five straight losses is not bad luck, that's a pattern — Bengals and Bills better look in the mirror before they look at the film. Dolphins at 5-0 got no room to relax, perfection is earned every single week, not just once. Jets and Broncos riding streaks — that's discipline showing up on Sundays —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Two teams sitting at 1-5, both fighting the same enemy — themselves. Atlanta's got the higher OVR gap in their favor by two points, but records don't lie and neither does effort. This game is about who's tired of losing and who's gotten comfortable with it —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Tom Brady
news.text:
B.Morrison, 5 INT, No. 2 in the league — that's a number that shows up in January.

(via TB12)

news.name: Tom Brady
news.text:
J.Price sits at No. 2 in the league with 664 rushing yards — good number, but I always played for No. 1.

(via TB12)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text: Forty-four points against ten. That's not a lucky bounce, that's a team that came to work while the other side came to watch. Discipline shows up on the scoreboard — (via Coach Boone)

news.name: Bobby Boucher
news.text: HOU done went and got themselves a fast, fast man in Travis Etienne Jr! Mama says speed is like water, ain't nothin gonna stop it from findin a way through — (via Bobby Boucher)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Perfect records don't happen by accident — Dolphins and Lions are 5-0 because they refuse to beat themselves. Meanwhile Bengals, Bills, and Raiders are proving losing is a habit just like winning is. Jaguars are building something real with three straight — that's what character looks like —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Bears come in 4-1 and playing like it. Falcons are 1-4 with a chip on their shoulder — desperate teams hit first and hit hardest. This is where character shows, not on paper —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text: Forty-eight to ten, forty-one to fourteen, forty-two to twenty-one — that is not luck, that is domination by design. Bucs, Jags, and Steelers came to work while three other teams came to spectate. Perfection is not a accident — (via Coach Boone)

news.name: Tom Brady
news.text: D.Lawrence, 7.5 sacks, now No. 2 in the league — that's a pass rush that shows up when it matters, and rings don't come without pressure like that. Championship defenses are built on numbers like this —(via TB12)

news.name: Tom Brady
news.text:
Gibbs sits at No. 2 in the league with 599 rushing yards.

Solid number — but championship backs find a way to No. 1 —(via TB12)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Forty to eight. That's not a win, that's a statement about who wanted it and who didn't. And Detroit — sixty-three points says your execution was perfect, but giving up thirty-eight says your discipline wasn't. Perfection is what we're after, not just points on a board —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Perfect is a number, not a character trait — the Dolphins better understand that at 4-0. Bengals, Raiders, four straight losses each — that's not a slump, that's a pattern, and patterns get you beat. Texans found three wins in a row — that's discipline showing up when it's needed —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
A 1-3 team walking into a 4-0 team's house — that tells me Seattle's found their character early and San Francisco is still searching for theirs. Rating on paper don't mean a thing if you don't execute for four quarters. Perfection is what I want out of both these teams, but only one is going to leave with it —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Tom Brady
news.text:
Goff sits No. 2 in the league with 1366 passing yards, Jacobs right there with him at No. 2 in rushing with 574 — production like that doesn't come with a participation trophy, it comes with expectations.

Now let's see who's No. 1 — (via TB12)

news.name: Coach Herman Boone
news.text:
Three teams put their foot on the throat and never let up. That's what execution looks like when effort is not optional. Perfection wasn't there for the defenses, but domination was —

(via Coach Boone)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text: LEADERBOARD ALERT: M. Williams (NE) climbs to No. 1 in league sacks with 7 sacks — (via Priya Shah)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text: LEADERBOARD ALERT: J. Horn climbs to No. 1 in league interceptions with 5 INT—(via Priya Shah)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text: LEADERBOARD ALERT: J. Milroe climbs to No. 3 in league passing yards with 890 passing yards this season—(via Priya Shah)

news.name: Coach Kellen Bates
news.text:
59-14, 52-14, 37-3 — that's not a slate, that's a demolition derby. Carolina and Green Bay didn't just win, they embarrassed. And Buffalo getting held to 3 points against the Chargers is a five-alarm fire in Orchard Park —

(via Coach Bates)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text: LEADERBOARD ALERT: D. Hall climbs to No. 1 in league sacks with 4.5 sacks — (via Priya Shah)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text:
LEADERBOARD ALERT: J. Ramsey climbs to No. 2 in league interceptions with 3 INT this season.

— (via Priya Shah)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text: LEADERBOARD ALERT: D. Claiborne climbs to No. 2 in league rushing yards with 253 rushing yds — (via Priya Shah)

news.name: Priya Shah
news.text:
LEADERBOARD ALERT: Drake Maye climbs to No. 2 in league passing yards with 694 passing yds this season.

—(via Priya Shah)

news.name: Coach Kellen Bates
news.text:
Three blowouts, three different flavors. SEA-AZ was a straight-up execution — 52-7 isn't a rivalry, it's a mercy rule. PIT-NE and CAR-ATL both cracked 50, but if your defense gives up 50 like NE and ATL did, you didn't lose a shootout, you lost a football game —

(via Coach Bates)
